business_updates: **Results season** — **15 companies filed** results or earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Puravankara** — enters a joint development agreement for a 7.83-acre land parcel in south-east Bengaluru, which it puts at **Rs 1,100 crore of gross development value** — a project-life figure, not an order book.
**AWL Agri Business** and **United Breweries** — each intimate a product launch, Fortune Yellow Mustard Oil in the first case.
capex_core: **Seshaasai Technologies** — buys a 1,600 sq m factory premises at Peenya IV Phase, Bangalore from M/s Balaji Industries for **Rs 17.21 crore**, to expand manufacturing capacity _(~0.3% of mcap)_.

**[Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/IMFA_25082026192602_Update_on_greenfield_ferro_chrome_expansion_Project.pdf)** — an update on its greenfield ferro chrome expansion project at Kalinganagar.
**ACME Solar Holdings** — wins **300 MW** in SECI's 6,000 MWh (1,500 MW x 4 hours) assured peak power tender, FDRE-IX; no contract value is stated.

**[Swelect Energy Systems](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SWELECTES_25082026131408_Reg_30_-_commissioning_of_10_MW_ESG_Green_signed.pdf)** — its subsidiary ESG Green Energy commissions a **10 MW solar power plant**.

**Ritco Logistics** — its step-down subsidiary TrucksUp Solutions closes a growth financing round; the round's parameters sit in an annexure past the end of the filing text we hold, so its size is not stated here.
**Striders Impex** — an additional investment of **Rs 3.28 crore**.
distress_risk: **Delta Autocorp** — discloses orders passed by the Office of the Principal Commissioner of Customs (Port), Kolkata, and says it intends to exercise its statutory remedies.
**IIFL Finance** — intimates the initiation of tax litigation concerning a material subsidiary, and an update on its own.

**[Sadbhav Engineering](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SADBHAV_25082026191154_SELAccessiontoMRASigningAnnouncement25082026.pdf)** — signs a Deed of Accession to the Master Restructuring Agreement under its corporate debt restructuring.
**Nuvoco Vistas** and **Shashijit Infraprojects** — disclose pending litigation, the latter a Gujarat High Court dispute over leased properties acquired from Vapi Municipal Corporation.
**AstraZeneca Pharma India** and **JSW Dulux** — each disclose actions taken or orders passed against them.

**[South India Paper Mills](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/0a9d9382-d0ec-454e-8151-f021df35ee40.pdf)** — a detailed public statement is filed for an open offer by Nandini and Kirit Modi for up to 48,75,000 equity shares.

**Compuage Infocom**, **Quadrant Televentures**, **Vas Infrastructure** and **Satiate Agri** — insolvency housekeeping: committee-of-creditors meetings, a replacement of the resolution professional, and a Form A public announcement.
equity_allotments: **Ather Energy** — allots **16,26,016 fully paid equity shares and 79,36,507 convertible warrants** under its preferential issue (new allotment).

**[Shree Hari Chemicals Export](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/d4741077-d5c2-4a1d-a09b-81257fe926f2.pdf)** — approves an issue of convertible warrants on a preferential basis (new).
**CWD**, **Shree Karni Fabcom** (1,05,000 shares) and **Modern Dairies** (16,00,000 shares) — allotments on the conversion of warrants issued earlier (past conversions, not new capital).
**Iris Clothings** and **Unihealth Hospitals** — receive in-principle approval for preferential issues of equity shares, a stage below allotment.

**NHC Foods** — allots **18,18,79,020 equity shares at Re 1** on the partial conversion of 19 FCCBs of USD 19,00,000, at an exchange rate of Rs 95.7258; 240 FCCBs of USD 1,00,000 remain outstanding (a past conversion, not new capital).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Netweb Technologies** — completes a **Rs 1,200 crore Qualified Institutions Placement**, allotting 25,05,219 equity shares at Rs 4,790 (a Rs 4,788 premium), its first equity raise since listing in July 2023, with proceeds earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes. The allotment was approved on 20 August; today's filing is the press release _(~3.9% of mcap)_.

**Jaykay Enterprises** — files the Letter of Offer for its **Rs 154.29 crore rights issue** of 2,05,71,642 partly paid shares at Rs 75, 3-for-19, record date 28 August — the terms approved on 20 August and published then, advanced one stage.

**NHC Foods** — board approves a **Rs 53.76 crore preferential issue of 25,60,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 2.10 each** to non-promoters, a price the filing states is not below the ICDR floor, with 25% payable upfront and the issue subject to shareholders _(~36% of mcap, proposed)_.

**Gujarat Themis Biosyn** — **opens a Qualified Institutions Placement**, adopting the preliminary placement document and setting a **floor price of Rs 372.57 a share** on a relevant date of 25 August, with discretion to offer up to a 5% discount. The issue size is not stated.
m_and_a: **Capitalnumbers Infotech** — completes the acquisition of 100% of **Epitome Cloud Inc**, a New Jersey Salesforce and enterprise-transformation consultancy with an Indian subsidiary, in a transaction valued at **Rs 40 crore** _(~19.8% of mcap)_.

**Orient Press** — board approves selling, transferring or leasing its Tarapur (MIDC) factory for a consideration of **not less than Rs 24 crore**, subject to shareholders at the 38th AGM. The buyer has not been decided, and the unit carries 29.72% of net worth on 5.26% of consolidated turnover _(~29.1% of mcap)_.

**Varun Beverages** — board approves incorporating **KIVA Spirits and Company**, a wholly owned Indian subsidiary taking the group into ready-to-drink and alcoholic beverages under Prathmesh Mishra as CEO, and a **75:25 Tunisian joint venture with Bevanda**; both are yet to be incorporated and no deal value arises.

**[Prataap Snacks](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/DIAMONDYD_25082026194704_IntimationofUpdateonAcquisition.pdf)** — an update on its acquisition of 99.95% of the equity of RLOP Food Processing.
**Honasa Consumer** — an update on the proposed acquisition of Fluence Pharma.
**Sonata Software** — intimates the effective date of the merger of a wholly owned subsidiary into itself.

**[Siyaram Silk Mills](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SIYSIL_25082026172359_SEIntimation_AllotmentofPrefernceShares.pdf)** — allots 18,14,80,352 Series I and 13,61,10,264 Series II preference shares as bonus under a Scheme of Arrangement.
**Sunita Tools** — signs an MoU for a strategic manufacturing and tendering collaboration for Ministry of Defence, government, PSU and DPSU tenders.
**Mish Designs** — acquires equity shares of I'Designs Fashions; **Zodiac Energy** and **Josts Engineering** each incorporate a wholly owned subsidiary.
order_wins: **Sigma Advanced Systems** — a further long-term **Rolls-Royce supply agreement of nearly £125 million (about Rs 1,600 crore on the filing's own conversion)**, won through its recently acquired UK subsidiary Bromford Precision Solutions, which will make aeroengine rings, casings and lock plates at Sigma's Indian and UK plants _(~13.8% of mcap)_.

**Sai Parenterals** — subsidiary Noumed Pharmaceuticals renews its long-term OTC medicines supply agreement with an unnamed Australian pharmacy chain for three years, at a projected **AUD 30 million, which the filing converts to about Rs 204 crore** at Rs 68.52 _(~8.7% of mcap)_.

**Advait Energy Transitions** — a **Rs 134.62 crore turnkey contract including taxes** from Madhya Pradesh Power Transmission for the design, manufacture and supply of emergency restoration systems for 400kV, 220kV and 132kV EHV lines, over 18 months _(~6.0% of mcap)_.

**Vinyas Innovative Technologies** — purchase orders for PCB assemblies **totalling Rs 109.78 crore**: Rs 89.85 crore from a foreign customer for delivery in 12-18 months and Rs 19.93 crore from a domestic one in 6-12 months _(~5.4% of mcap)_.

**BMW Ventures** — **two purchase orders worth Rs 24.98 crore including taxes** from Tata Projects for FE-550D TMT steel for the 3x800 MW USCTPP-Adani project, on 100% advance payment and to be delivered within eight weeks _(~5.1% of mcap)_.

**Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants** — a **Rs 10.41 crore work order** from the Collector's office at Buldhana for the selection of licensed surveyors for the District Superintendent of Land Records _(~3.3% of mcap)_.

**Relicab Cable Manufacturing** — an **Rs 8.26 crore order including GST** for control cables from a customer it identifies only as one of the world's leading energy technology companies operating in India, withheld as commercially sensitive, for delivery by 30 September _(~22.9% of mcap)_.
**Aptech** — a contract from an unnamed state government body to conduct computer-based examinations, with an estimated value of **Rs 7.23 crore**, to be executed in Q2 FY27 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.

**Innomet Advanced Materials** — a purchase order from Advantage Metal Powders of Pennsylvania for copper powder, which its own Regulation 30 disclosure values at **Rs 3.29 crore (USD 345,291)** _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**[Suzlon Energy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SUZLON1_25082026093153_Suzlon_25082026.pdf)** — announces a **new 250 MW wind order from Torrent**, taking the two companies' partnership past 1.3 GW; the filing's rupee value did not reach the feed.

**[Jaykay Enterprises](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/JAYKAY_25082026200023_SE_Intimation_ALLEN.pdf)** — its step-down subsidiary Allen Reinforced Plastics receives an order from **BrahMos Aerospace**; no value reached the feed.
**VA Tech Wabag** — announces a project win in Kuwait; the release's value did not reach the feed.
**Marushika Technology** — a **Rs 2.41 crore** order from the National Highways Authority of India _(~2.6% of mcap; SME)_.
other_notable: **PVR Inox** — its board will consider a proposal to buy back equity shares.
**Gandhi Special Tubes** — an update on its buyback of up to 8,68,100 equity shares of Rs 5 face value; **Advanced Enzyme Technologies** and **SIS** continue open-market buybacks.
**Abhishek Integrations** — allots 63,38,070 securities as a bonus issue.
**Oriana Power** — fixes **18 September 2026** as the record date for its split/subdivision.
**Chalet Hotels** — rebrands Four Points by Sheraton Navi Mumbai as Athiva Pulse, an Autograph Collection hotel.
**CEAT** — reports the conclusion of a matter previously disclosed.
**Arvind** — CARE **upgrades its long-term rating to AA (Stable) from AA- (Stable)**, reaffirming the short-term rating at A1+.

**Veefin Solutions** — subsidiary Infini Systems signs a Business Transfer Agreement to sell its business as a going concern to **Nityo Tech for Rs 30 crore**; Nityo Tech is Infini's own subsidiary, so the undertaking moves within the group _(~4.9% of mcap)_.
